# macro.gaussian_beam_peak_intensity { #clerq.macro.gaussian_beam_peak_intensity }

```python
macro.gaussian_beam_peak_intensity(power, waist)
```

Peak intensity of a circular Gaussian beam, ``2 P / (pi w^2)``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                            | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------|------------|
| power  | float  | Total beam power, in mW.               | _required_ |
| waist  | float  | The ``1/e^2`` intensity radius, in cm. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                |
|--------|--------|----------------------------|
|        | float  | Peak intensity in mW/cm^2. |
